question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR builder, editing a manual KPI's value recomputes its delta-vs-last-MBR automatically; for a cohort (SubReading[]) manual KPI, how is per-sub-source inline editing handled, and how is each source's "change vs last MBR" recomputed and matched to the previous published MBR's sub-readings (by label, by order)?
recommendation: The premise does not hold in the current codebase: there is NO automatic 'delta-vs-last-MBR' recomputation for any manual KPI (scalar OR cohort), so nothing matches sub-readings against the previous published MBR today. Per-sub-source cohort editing exists only as plain {label,value} row editing in UpdateKpisView's ManualValueEditor (which just emits an updated SubReading[]); MbrBuilderView's editKpi only patches the value and persists the draft, computing no diff. If a per-source 'change vs last MBR' is desired, it must be BUILT, and it should match sub-readings by their `label` (the only stable identifier) with positional order as a fallback tie-breaker, since SubReading carries no id.
supporting_points: No delta logic exists: grepping src for delta/change-vs/vs-last/previous-mbr/diff finds only unrelated hits (CSS tokens, doc strings). MbrBuilderView.editKpi merely does `{...k, ...patch}` and calls saveSnapshot with no reference to any prior locked snapshot, and MetricValueCell renders values with no change/delta display.

Cohort inline editing lives in UpdateKpisView's ManualValueEditor: it seeds SubReading[] rows from kpi.value, edits each row's label/value via cohort-label-<id>-<i> / cohort-value-<id>-<i> inputs, and emits the full updated SubReading[] on change (verified by DefaultView.manualValueEditor.test.tsx). MbrBuilderView itself doesn't even support cohort editing for unwired KPIs — it renders a single text input bound to `typeof kpi.value === 'string' ? kpi.value : ''`.

The data model gives no basis for a stable per-source match: SubReading is only { label: string; value: string } (shared/types.ts) with no id/key, values are free-text strings (e.g. '5.46 days') not numbers, and locked snapshots are immutable self-contained blobs — so any future 'change vs last MBR' must join sub-readings by `label` (order only as a fallback) and parse the string values to compute a numeric delta.
